description: Selects the consultation fee code (초진 10100 / 재진 10200) and its 8-digit 산정코드 modifiers (age, night, 심야, Saturday, holiday, proxy receipt) from visit time, patient RRN, clinic settings and the prior-visit window.

inputSchema.fn: Which original function the case exercises: 'lee' (modifier calculation), 'Vdn' (auto-insert 초진/재진 lines), '_t.New' (decode a code), 'JLt' (procedure-code modifiers, related).
inputSchema.수가코드: lee/_t.New: 5-digit base code ('10100' 초진, '10200' 재진) or full 8-digit code to decode.
inputSchema.기준일시: Visit datetime 'yyyyMMddHHmm', interpreted in the clinic's local time (Asia/Seoul).
inputSchema.주민번호뒷자리: RRN back part; only its first digit (century/sex) is used.
inputSchema.설정: 진료설정 from GET /settings/treatments: 연령에따른시술료가산적용여부, 야간진료시진찰료가산여부, 시니어환자제외여부, 토요일공휴일시니어환자제외여부, 주간진찰료산정기준시작시간 (HHmm, default 0900), 주간진찰료산정기준종료시간 (HHmm, default 1800), 초진진찰료산정기준일 (days, default 0), 초진환자처방시변증기술료적용여부.
inputSchema.holidays: Map keyed by 'yyyyMMdd' from GET /settings/holidays/public-holidays/{yyyy}; only key presence matters.
inputSchema.비대면진료임: Telemedicine pilot visit; disables all modifiers.
inputSchema.토요가산강제적용: Set only by the manual 토요일 toggle in TreatmentPayment.
inputSchema.최근진료기록목록: Vdn: recent records {진료Id, 기준일시} fetched with days_ago/limit = 초진진찰료산정기준일 for 건보/급여.
inputSchema.수가코드목록: Vdn: fee master rows for the selected 적용일자 (see reference-version-selection); fee names/prices in this fixture are synthetic.
inputSchema.진료Id: Vdn: id of the current record, excluded from the prior-visit search.
inputSchema.처방: JLt: {수가코드, 카테고리숫자코드} of a procedure/medication line; flags 공휴일임, 야간임, 토요주간임, 자락도침산침술법, 사암오행체질침법, 화침온침, 산정코드재설정.

openQuestions: 만나이계산_일곱자리 builds the birth date as new Date(year, month, day) without month-1, so for patients born within the last month the age is null and every age modifier (만1세미만 1, 신생아 1, 1~6세 6) and the 65+ senior exclusion are skipped. Is this intended or a bug the server should not copy?
Saturday surcharge is emitted as a second line (base code plus code with second digit 3) instead of replacing the base code. Should the server keep the two-line representation?
If the computed 8-digit code is missing from the fee master for the date (e.g. 10100610), no consultation line is added at all and no error is shown. Should the server reject or fall back?

Prior-visit window compares full timestamps (strictly after 기준일시 minus N days, strictly before the current 기준일시), not calendar dates. The server-side recent-record query also filters by days_ago whose exact semantics are not visible in the client.
초진진찰료산정기준일 default is 0, which makes every visit 초진. Is 0 a real configuration or an unset sentinel?
For 자보/산재/일반 visits the recent-record query uses a 90-day (or 산재-specific) window while the 초진/재진 decision still uses 초진진찰료산정기준일; confirm which window the server should apply.
Holidays come from a per-year map of the visit year only; behaviour when the map fails to load is an empty map (holiday treated as weekday) for errors, and no auto-insert while loading.
토요일공휴일시니어환자제외여부 suppresses holiday and Saturday surcharges for age >= 65 but night surcharge still applies on those days; confirm.
